category: MediaPipe / Google AI Edge / MediaPipe Tasks / Web ML
headline: MediaPipe の結果を Decision / Retrieval へ渡す前に readiness と文脈予算で絞る
headlineEn: Gate MediaPipe results with readiness and context budgets before Decision and Retrieval handoff
summary: Google AI Edge の Web setup、Gesture Recognizer guide、GestureRecognizer JavaScript API、MediaPipe releases、mediapipe-samples-web、公式 Tasks Web demo を確認し、自作サンプルを2本追加しました。本命は Decision Handoff Readiness Board、派生は Retrieval Context Budget Router です。
summaryEn: After checking the Google AI Edge Web setup guide, Gesture Recognizer guide, GestureRecognizer JavaScript API, MediaPipe releases, mediapipe-samples-web, and the official Tasks Web demo, this adds two original samples: Decision Handoff Readiness Board and Retrieval Context Budget Router.
keyTopics: MediaPipe Tasks の Web setup は vision / text / audio / genai の prebuilt library と `BaseOptions`、`modelAssetPath`、delegate を整理しており、複数 Task の結果を同じ handoff gate に載せる設計と相性がよい。
Gesture Recognizer Web guide は `IMAGE` / `VIDEO` の running mode、`recognize()` / `recognizeForVideo()`、timestamp 付き video frame 処理を示しているため、今日は同期推論結果をそのまま行動へ渡さない readiness gate を作った。
GestureRecognizer JavaScript API では `recognizeForVideo()` が video mode で同期的に結果を返すため、Worker や frame budget だけでなく、後段アクションの fire / review / hold / block も明示したい。
mediapipe-samples-web と公式 Tasks Web demo には Decision Maker、Semantic Retriever、Universal Embedder が並んでおり、MediaPipe の認識結果を rule / retrieval / multimodal embedding へ渡す後段設計が重要になっている。
GitHub の MediaPipe releases では v1.1.0 が最新として見えており、Web Tasks の更新を追いながら、日次アーカイブでは実 Task の手前と後段をつなぐ最小 UI を蓄積する。
keyTopicsEn: The MediaPipe Tasks Web setup guide organizes prebuilt vision / text / audio / genai libraries along with `BaseOptions`, `modelAssetPath`, and delegates, which fits a shared handoff gate for multiple task outputs.

The Gesture Recognizer Web guide covers `IMAGE` / `VIDEO` running modes, `recognize()` / `recognizeForVideo()`, and timestamped video-frame processing, so today builds a readiness gate before turning synchronous inference into actions.

The GestureRecognizer JavaScript API notes that `recognizeForVideo()` returns results synchronously in video mode, so downstream fire / review / hold / block routing should be explicit in addition to worker and frame-budget planning.

mediapipe-samples-web and the official Tasks Web demo now surface Decision Maker, Semantic Retriever, and Universal Embedder examples, making downstream rule / retrieval / multimodal embedding design increasingly relevant.

GitHub MediaPipe releases currently show v1.1.0 as the latest, so the daily archive should keep watching Web Tasks changes while accumulating small UI bridges between real tasks and downstream app logic.

sections.title: 注目事例と何が面白いか
sections.titleEn: Notable example and why it matters
sections.body: 今日の注目は、公式 Tasks Web demo に Decision Maker、Semantic Retriever、Universal Embedder が並んでいることです。MediaPipe の認識結果は、画面に描くだけでなく、ルール判断、検索文脈、外部アクションへ渡す前処理として使われます。そこで今日は、Gesture / Object / Embedder / Classifier 風の合成結果を action readiness と context budget で絞る自作サンプルにしました。
sections.bodyEn: Today's notable point is that the official Tasks Web demo includes Decision Maker, Semantic Retriever, and Universal Embedder. MediaPipe recognition results are useful not only for rendering overlays but also as preprocessed evidence for rule decisions, retrieval context, and external actions. Today's original samples therefore gate synthetic Gesture / Object / Embedder / Classifier-style results with action readiness and context budgets.

sections.title: 表現・インタラクションのアイデア
sections.body: 本命の `Decision Handoff Readiness Board` は、合成 evidence lane を confidence、freshness、ambiguity、action risk で評価し、fire / review / hold / block に振り分けます。派生の `Retrieval Context Budget Router` は、MediaPipe 由来の短い digest を novelty、recency、privacy strictness、byte budget で send / compress / hold / drop に分けます。どちらも実 Task ではなく、後段設計だけを触れる最小サンプルです。
sections.bodyEn: The main sample, `Decision Handoff Readiness Board`, evaluates synthetic evidence lanes with confidence, freshness, ambiguity, and action risk, then routes them into fire / review / hold / block. The derivative, `Retrieval Context Budget Router`, routes short MediaPipe-derived digests through novelty, recency, privacy strictness, and byte budgets into send / compress / hold / drop. Both are minimal downstream-design samples rather than live task demos.

sections.title: サンプルデータの可能性と組み合わせ
sections.titleEn: Possibilities unlocked by sample data and combinations
sections.body: 蓄積できるデータは evidence lane、confidence、freshness、ambiguity、action risk、readiness、route timeline、explanation token 数、digest title、novelty、recency、privacy risk、byte budget、send / compress / hold / drop 履歴です。Gesture Recognizer、Object Detector、Image Embedder、Image Classifier、Image Segmenter、Language Detector、Decision Maker、Semantic Retriever、Universal Embedder、IndexedDB、Worker、監査ログ、ユーザー承認 UI と組み合わせると、オンデバイス推論から判断・検索・外部送信までの橋渡しを段階的に設計できます。
sections.bodyEn: The samples can accumulate evidence lanes, confidence, freshness, ambiguity, action risk, readiness, route timelines, explanation token counts, digest titles, novelty, recency, privacy risk, byte budgets, and send / compress / hold / drop history. Combined with Gesture Recognizer, Object Detector, Image Embedder, Image Classifier, Image Segmenter, Language Detector, Decision Maker, Semantic Retriever, Universal Embedder, IndexedDB, workers, audit logs, and user approval UI, they support staged design from on-device inference to decisions, retrieval, and external transmission.

sections.title: 制作に使えそうな技術メモ
sections.body: 実装時は `recognizeForVideo()` のような同期 video inference を Worker 側で扱い、main thread では action readiness と説明文だけを受け取る形にすると扱いやすいです。`BaseOptions` の `modelAssetPath` と delegate、Task ごとの running mode、timestamp 単調性、結果の freshness TTL、risk 別の approval policy を別々にログ化すると、後段 Decision / Retrieval の誤作動を調整できます。
sections.bodyEn: In production, keep synchronous video inference such as `recognizeForVideo()` in a worker and pass only action readiness plus short explanations back to the main thread. Logging `BaseOptions.modelAssetPath`, delegates, per-task running modes, timestamp monotonicity, result freshness TTL, and risk-specific approval policy separately makes downstream Decision / Retrieval behavior easier to tune.

sections.title: 明日以降ウォッチする対象
sections.body: 明日以降は MediaPipe v1.1.0 以降の Web Tasks asset、mediapipe-samples-web の Decision Maker / Retriever / Universal Embedder 実装、Gesture Recognizer の guide と API 更新、Web setup guide の CDN / npm パス、LiteRT-LM への移行案、WebNN / WebGPU delegate 周辺、privacy notice と telemetry の扱いを追います。
sections.bodyEn: Next, watch Web Tasks assets after MediaPipe v1.1.0, Decision Maker / Retriever / Universal Embedder implementations in mediapipe-samples-web, Gesture Recognizer guide and API updates, CDN / npm paths in the Web setup guide, LiteRT-LM migration notes, WebNN / WebGPU delegate behavior, and privacy notice / telemetry handling.

sections.title: 試すならこれ
sections.body: `Decision Handoff Readiness Board` で Action risk を high にし、Decision threshold を上げると、同じ confidence でも fire から review / hold へ寄ります。`Retrieval Context Budget Router` では Privacy strictness を上げ、Context byte budget を下げると、face cue や大きな mask digest が compress / drop に寄り、検索へ渡す情報量が小さくなります。
sections.bodyEn: In `Decision Handoff Readiness Board`, set action risk to high and raise the decision threshold to see the same confidence move from fire toward review / hold. In `Retrieval Context Budget Router`, raise privacy strictness and lower the context byte budget to push face cues and large mask digests toward compress / drop, reducing the information passed to retrieval.

sections.title: 進行マップ
sections.body: 調査: Google AI Edge Web setup、Gesture Recognizer Web guide、GestureRecognizer JavaScript API、GitHub MediaPipe releases、mediapipe-samples-web、公式 Tasks Web demo を確認。設計: 10月11日の semantic digest / payload minimization の次段として、Decision handoff と Retrieval context budget に焦点を移した。実装: 本命 HTML に evidence lane、readiness、risk、explanation token、decision timeline を追加。派生 HTML に digest card、novelty、recency、privacy risk、byte budget、route timeline を追加。検証: JSON parse、gallery build、publish command、GitHub Pages の top / day / representative sample HTTP 200 を確認する。
sections.bodyEn: Research: checked Google AI Edge Web setup, the Gesture Recognizer Web guide, the GestureRecognizer JavaScript API, GitHub MediaPipe releases, mediapipe-samples-web, and the official Tasks Web demo. Design: after the October 11 semantic digest / payload minimization work, shift focus to Decision handoff and Retrieval context budgets. Implementation: the main HTML adds evidence lanes, readiness, risk, explanation tokens, and a decision timeline. The derivative HTML adds digest cards, novelty, recency, privacy risk, byte budgets, and a route timeline. Validation: check JSON parsing, gallery build, publish command, and GitHub Pages HTTP 200 for the top page, day page, and representative sample.

sections.title: 俯瞰メモ
sections.body: この日次アーカイブは、camera permission、running mode、worker queue、mask lifecycle、multitask scheduling、confidence fusion、release preflight、landmark / gesture stabilization、semantic digest、payload minimization まで進みました。今日はそこに、安定化された結果を判断や検索へ渡す直前の安全弁を足しました。Web ML のアプリでは、推論を増やすよりも、いつ・どれだけ・どのリスクで次へ渡すかを可視化することが効きます。
sections.bodyEn: This daily archive has covered camera permission, running modes, worker queues, mask lifecycle, multitask scheduling, confidence fusion, release preflight, landmark / gesture stabilization, semantic digests, and payload minimization. Today adds the safety valve just before stabilized results are handed to decisions or retrieval. In Web ML apps, visualizing when, how much, and with what risk to pass results onward can matter more than adding more inference.

sections.title: 今日のミニ試作候補
sections.body: 採用した本命は `Decision Handoff Readiness Board` です。実際に動く部分は、Gesture / Object / Embedder / Classifier 風の合成 evidence を confidence、freshness、ambiguity、action risk で score 化し、fire / review / hold / block に振り分けるところです。次に足すなら real Gesture Recognizer の `recognizeForVideo()`、Object Detector の ROI、Image Embedder の digest、Decision Maker へ渡す JSON schema、ユーザー承認 UI を追加します。派生試作は `Retrieval Context Budget Router` で、実際に動く部分は MediaPipe 由来の短い digest を novelty、recency、privacy strictness、byte budget で send / compress / hold / drop に分けるところです。次に足すなら Semantic Retriever の実 query、Universal Embedder の cross-modal score、IndexedDB への context 保存、監査ログを追加します。
sections.bodyEn: The selected main prototype is `Decision Handoff Readiness Board`. The working pieces score synthetic Gesture / Object / Embedder / Classifier-style evidence with confidence, freshness, ambiguity, and action risk, then route it into fire / review / hold / block. Next additions should include real Gesture Recognizer `recognizeForVideo()`, Object Detector ROI, Image Embedder digests, a JSON schema for Decision Maker, and user approval UI. The derivative prototype is `Retrieval Context Budget Router`; it routes short MediaPipe-derived digests through novelty, recency, privacy strictness, and byte budgets into send / compress / hold / drop. Next additions should include real Semantic Retriever queries, Universal Embedder cross-modal scores, IndexedDB context storage, and audit logs.
